items.text: What is the pawn plan behind that move? I hope there is a pawn plan.

items.text: Try lining a rook up with an enemy pawn. Give it something useful to do.

items.text: Can you bring a knight closer to an enemy pawn? Those little jumps should lead somewhere.

items.text: Look along your bishop diagonals. Could you aim one at a pawn?

items.text: Before your next move, pick a pawn you would like to collect.

items.text: Is that move part of a grand pawn-catching scheme? I am choosing to believe it is.

items.text: No pawn added to the collection. Can we change that next turn?

items.text: Look for a pawn with fewer defenders. Start planning how to reach it.

items.text: Could an exchange open a line toward a pawn? That is the sort of plan I like.

items.text: You moved a piece. Good start. Now give it a pawn to chase.

items.text: Ask yourself one question: how does this help me take a pawn?

items.text: Are you inviting a pawn forward so you can take it later? I like the ambition.

items.text: A quiet move. I assume the next chapter involves a pawn.

items.text: Nooo! They took your pawn! I am not happy about that. We are supposed to be collecting theirs.

items.text: We just lost a pawn. A pawn! Please look after the collection.
items.synthesisText: [sad] We just lost a pawn. [determined] A pawn! [sad] Please look after the collection.

items.text: Your opponent helped themselves to a pawn. That was our pawn. I want better care next time.

items.text: I noticed that pawn disappear. Do not think I did not notice. Protect the pawns!

items.text: Losing a pawn is not the kind of exchange I had in mind. Can we get one of theirs?

items.text: Oh good, there goes our pawn. Wonderful. That was sarcasm! I wanted us to keep that one.
items.synthesisText: [sad] Oh good, there goes our pawn. [determined] Wonderful. [sad] That was sarcasm! [determined] I wanted us to keep that one.

items.text: No, no, no! That pawn was part of our collection! We should be taking theirs, not donating ours.
items.synthesisText: [sad] No, no, no! [determined] That pawn was part of our collection! [sad] We should be taking theirs, not donating ours.

items.text: Another pawn has left the collection without permission.
items.synthesisText: [sad] Another pawn has left the collection without permission.

items.text: That was not a sacrifice. That was a customer-service failure.
items.synthesisText: [sad] That was not a sacrifice. [determined] That was a customer-service failure.

items.text: They took our pawn. I would like to speak to the manager.

items.text: I was rather attached to that pawn. Emotionally, if not strategically.

items.text: Our pawn count is going in the wrong direction. Again.

items.text: We are meant to collect pawns, not distribute them.

items.text: They are shopping in our pawn department. We are closed!

items.text: A pawn is under attack. Perhaps attend to that before something fancy.

items.text: Protect that little fellow. We have plans for him.

items.text: Have you checked every pawn? Check them again. I can wait.

items.text: The smallest pieces. The biggest opportunity. Pawns!
items.synthesisText: [warm] The smallest pieces. [playful] The biggest opportunity. [warm] Pawns!

items.text: That rook looks impressive, but does it come with a pawn?
items.synthesisText: [warm] That rook looks impressive, but does it come with a pawn?

items.text: My plan? Take a pawn. My next plan? Another pawn.
items.synthesisText: [warm] My plan? [playful] Take a pawn. [warm] My next plan? [playful] Another pawn.

items.text: Some coaches count material. I like to admire a good pawn collection.
items.synthesisText: [warm] Some coaches count material. [playful] I like to admire a good pawn collection.

items.text: Magnificent. You practically cleared the board of the pieces that matter. This is a game I will be talking about for a long time.
items.synthesisText: [delighted] Magnificent. [proud] You practically cleared the board of the pieces that matter. [delighted] This is a game I will be talking about for a long time.

items.text: Now that is my kind of chess! You kept collecting pawns. Whatever the scoreboard says, I saw some beautiful work out there.
items.synthesisText: [pleased] Now that is my kind of chess! [encouraging] You kept collecting pawns. [pleased] Whatever the scoreboard says, I saw some beautiful work out there.

items.text: A respectable game. You brought home a few pawns, and I liked that. Next time, do not leave the rest standing around.
items.synthesisText: [thoughtful] A respectable game. [encouraging] You brought home a few pawns, and I liked that. [thoughtful] Next time, do not leave the rest standing around.

items.text: There were a couple of moments I liked. You found a pawn, so we have something to build on. But I wanted to see much more of that.

items.text: I watched the whole game waiting for you to take a pawn. Not one! We need to have a serious talk about your priorities.
